about: New idea: you bending the rules of golf, 6 bits from 6 different rounds/shirts. 1) cart path: "isn't there a rule… drop the ball like one club-length back" → "surely I can at least take that stick out of the way… I hit the ball. You didn't see that." 2) "lock your guess in before I hit my drive, otherwise that's cheating… cheaters never win. I think that's from the Bible." 3) teeing off with a putter → "that doesn't count, that doesn't count" 4) "I just dropped one, I believe you boys call this a gallery drop, and if you don't, I don't care" 5) driver slips → "I'm gonna grab another ball" → re-tee → "that's better" 6) out of the cactus: "I'm just gonna take a drop out here, shut up." Every shot whole, nothing cut mid-sentence, no added text, no wipe, one full-quality export from your Golf Captions originals. Set to @mackygolfs (no wipe in it, so it also works on @mackthegolfer).
